modules.name: Report Board Dimensions
modules.description: Report dimensions, mounting-hole offsets, and fiducial offsets for the board open in PCB Editor.

risk.summary: Reads the open board through KiCad IPC without changing it.

modules.name: Check BOM Stock
modules.description: Compare a schematic BOM with the component stock workbook and report shortages or metadata errors.

parameters.name: schematic
parameters.label: Schematic
parameters.description: Schematic to check; omit to discover the schematic open in KiCad.

parameters.name: workbook
parameters.label: Stock workbook
parameters.description: Workbook containing the stock table.

parameters.name: sheet
parameters.label: Sheet
parameters.description: Workbook sheet containing stock data.

parameters.name: minimum_stock
parameters.label: Minimum stock
parameters.description: Minimum acceptable quantity for each BOM item.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Reads project and workbook files and creates only a temporary netlist.

modules.name: Generate JLCPCB Files
modules.description: Generate fabrication Gerbers, drill data, BOM, and placement files for one KiCad project.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: Project directory, .kicad_pro file, or .kicad_pcb file.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Creates or replaces manufacturing artifacts beneath the selected project.

modules.name: Panelize Routed PCB
modules.description: Create a routed mouse-bite production panel from a KiCad PCB.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input PCB
parameters.description: Source board file.

parameters.name: count_x
parameters.label: Horizontal count
parameters.description: Number of boards across the panel.

parameters.name: count_y
parameters.label: Vertical count
parameters.description: Number of boards down the panel.

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output PCB
parameters.description: Destination panel file; parent directories may be created.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.label: Board gap
parameters.description: Routed gap between boards in millimetres.

parameters.name: rail
parameters.label: Rail width
parameters.description: Perimeter process rail in millimetres.

parameters.name: tab_width
parameters.label: Tab width
parameters.description: Breakaway-tab width in millimetres.

parameters.name: mouse_bite_diameter
parameters.label: Mouse-bite diameter
parameters.description: Mouse-bite drill diameter in millimetres.

parameters.name: mouse_bite_clearance
parameters.label: Mouse-bite clearance
parameters.description: Edge-to-edge drill clearance in millimetres.

parameters.name: force
parameters.label: Replace output
parameters.description: Allow replacement of an existing output file.

risk.summary: Creates a panel file and can replace it when explicitly requested.

modules.name: Manufacture JLCPCB Panel
modules.description: Panelize a project and generate its complete JLCPCB fabrication and assembly package.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: Project directory
parameters.description: Directory containing its same-named board file.

parameters.name: count_x
parameters.label: Horizontal count
parameters.description: Number of boards across the panel.

parameters.name: count_y
parameters.label: Vertical count
parameters.description: Number of boards down the panel.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Replaces the generated panel and manufacturing package in the project output directory.

modules.name: Stop KiCad
modules.description: Terminate KiCad processes owned by the current user and remove stale IPC sockets.

risk.summary: Terminates external application processes and may discard unsaved work.
